data.name: Hon Cars
data.detailed_description:
HON CARS is an open-world multiplayer experience where freedom, exploration, and creativity come together. Explore a huge detailed map, drive a wide variety of vehicles, fly planes, build your own house, and create your own story in a living world.

The game features a third-person perspective character system with many activities and possibilities. Buy, customize, and drive cars, interact with NPCs, discover new locations, collect items, and enjoy a dynamic open-world environment.

Features include:

🚗 Vehicles System – Drive different cars, explore the map, and experience realistic vehicle gameplay.
✈️ Aircraft System – Take control of planes and explore the world from above.
🏠 House Building System – Build and customize your own home.
🐾 Pet System – Own pets and interact with them.
🔫 Weapons System – Use different weapons and equipment.
🎒 Inventory System – Manage your items and resources.
👕 Clothing System – Customize your character with different outfits.
🚦 Traffic & NPC System – Experience a world filled with vehicles and characters.
🛒 Buy & Sell System – Trade items and manage your economy.
💃 Emote System – Express yourself with different animations.

HON CARS is currently in development. This is the Beta version, and many new features, improvements, and content are planned for future updates.

Press Play and join us in building the world of HON CARS! 🚗🔥

data.short_description: Hon Cars is an open world game with a TPS character that contains many cars, planes, you can build your own house, and many other interesting things. The game has detailed graphics and a very large map.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i3
  • Memory: 5 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i5
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
